simple.meaning: עֲרָבוֹן (ʻărâbôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “a pawn (given as security).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עֲרָבוֹן (H6162) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 38:17, with occurrences in Genesis.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲרָבוֹן (H6162) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עֲרָבוֹן (H6162) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עֲרָבוֹן (ʻărâbôwn) / H6162 is traced through Genesis 38:17, Genesis 38:18, Genesis 38:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.”

timeline.evidenceText: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.”
He said, “What pledge will I give you?”
Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.
